title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: DeferredLock exposes a method `locked()`; accessing it as a property returns the method object, which is truthy, so the condition is always false and the lock is always awaited, negating the intended optimization.

title: Missing await on lock acquisition
detail: When the lock is free, the code calls `self._export_lock.acquire()` without awaiting the returned Deferred, so the lock acquisition may not complete before the item is processed, leading to race conditions.
